shortDescription: Armani is scheduled to hold meetings with LVMH EURONEXT:MC, beauty giant L'Oreal EURONEXT:OR and eyewear group EssilorLuxottica EURONEXT:EL over a possible sale of a minority stake in the coming weeks, the Financial Times reported on Sunday.
